mutation: A `confidence` field was added to the emitted edge in GraphRepository#toEdge, computed as live assertions divided by total assertions — the plausible, well-meant version of the field somebody would add to be helpful.
performedBy: manual mutation during Phase 3D. The recursive abstention scan reported it twice — once for the field name and once for the numeric value — and 'no numeric judgement or score-like field is emitted anywhere in the graph' went false. GR-G3 is the only guarantee in the registry about what is never emitted, and this is the shape of the change that would break it: not malicious, just helpful.
